findings.summary: the startup window is lowered from 30.0 to 15.0 seconds, below the plan §19 requirement of 'at least 30'
findings.text: blocking: SANDBOX_STARTUP_WINDOW_SECONDS is set to 15.0 where the plan section §19 states the window is 'a stated number of seconds, at least 30, which covers the four seconds that launch took from launch to exit and the step start before it' (docs/plans/a-worker-cannot-write-your-home.html:1592). The recorded rationale for the reduction is the window's upper bound (a child that exits inside the window is recorded as a launch failure), which does not establish 15 s as sufficient for the slow step start the section exists to catch; on a loaded host an srun step start before the child's refusal is exactly the interval the 30 s floor was chosen to cover, so the fix now misses refusals it was written to retry. The measured fixture still passes at 4 s, which is why the gate does not catch it.
